title: hal_bridge.c fails -Werror=switch-enum on native_sim (missing enum cases)
description: Found while verifying project-LICHEN-worker6-6fg3 on AWS waves-base (native_sim/native/64, gcc 11.5, meshcore_gateway_adapter image): lichen/subsys/lichen/app_interface/hal_bridge.c:172 switch (app_class) does not handle LICHEN_APP_LOCATION_SOURCE_NONE/_ONBOARD_HARDWARE/_EXTERNAL_HARDWARE/_LOCAL_CLIENT, and hal_bridge.c:410 switch (source_class) does not handle LICHEN_HAL_TIME_SOURCE_* entries. The module hardening set in lichen/zephyr/CMakeLists.txt makes -Wswitch-enum fatal (-Werror), so any image building CONFIG_LICHEN_APP_INTERFACE fails at compile. Likely convergence point with in-flight hal.h enum work; add the missing cases (or default) in hal_bridge.c.
close_reason: Fixed on AWS waves-base gcc 11.5 with the lichen/zephyr hardening set (-Wswitch-enum -Werror visible on compile lines): hal_bridge.c:172 switch(app_class) now handles LICHEN_APP_LOCATION_SOURCE_NONE/_ONBOARD_HARDWARE/_EXTERNAL_HARDWARE/_LOCAL_CLIENT and hal_bridge.c:410 switch(source_class) handles LICHEN_HAL_TIME_SOURCE_NONE/_MONOTONIC_INTERNAL/_INTERNAL_RTC/_GNSS, both grouped case:default per file convention, behavior unchanged (same returns). Convergence blocker found during image verify: meshcore/adapter.c:396 same -Werror=switch-enum class (LICHEN_MESHCORE_PENDING_MAX unhandled) — added case grouped with default. meshcore_gateway_adapter image: BUILD EXIT 0 (could not compile at all before; proven by revert-test). ztest run: 13 PASS then pre-existing stack overflow in test_send_channel_text_allows_external_emit_after_ack (idle thread) — filed project-LICHEN-worker6-1qmi, unrelated to switch labels.
